mechanisms: DiscourseTopicIR carries a typed anchor kind, exact group identity, live revision, membership hash, non-authority flags, and a topic hash.
TopicTransitionIR is a serialized hash-sealed record with distinct applied and unresolved forms and no semantic or execution authority.
Returning to a suspended group topic rebinds its stable group ID to the live revision and membership hash.
Group revisions refresh every matching active or suspended topic anchor without changing topic identity.
Generic group references prefer an exact active group anchor over recency and topic-key similarity, including after long interruption.
Composite and overlapping groups restore by exact identity; ambiguity, missing targets, out-of-range history, and quotation fail closed.
Grounded realization emits a discourse-topic-transition claim bound to transition, topic, and group-membership hashes.
